_notes: base_scores are on a 0-10 scale representing foot traffic potential in ideal conditions. weights control how much each factor adjusts that base score. Tune these over time using calibrate_weights.py once results_log.json has 10+ entries.

eastern_market.notes: Strongest morning location. Flea market draws 5000+ visitors Saturdays 7am-1pm. Dies sharply after 2pm. Weather-dependent — rain cuts foot traffic significantly.

dupont_circle.notes: Consistent Metro foot traffic all day. Farmers market is Sunday, not Saturday — no bonus. Moderate weather sensitivity. Good fallback morning location.

national_mall.notes: Highest tourist volume in DC but extremely weather-dependent. Outdoor exposure makes it dangerous in rain or cold. Peaks mid-morning through afternoon on good weather days.

georgetown_waterfront.notes: Scenic afternoon destination for joggers and leisure crowd. Strongest weather dependency of all locations — avoid in rain or cold. Strong in warm sunny afternoons.

u_street_corridor.notes: Evening/nightlife focused. Weak mornings. Picks up mid-afternoon. Best when there are concerts or cultural events nearby. Lower weather sensitivity than waterfront locations.

convention_center.notes: Binary location — excellent with a major convention (5k-15k attendees), nearly dead without one. Weather-independent. Must confirm event booking weekly before deploying.

capital_one_arena.notes: Wizards/Capitals games drive this entirely. 18k capacity. Bad weather actively increases value (people prefer indoor events). Pre-game window 2-3 hours before tip is peak. Dead on non-game days.

columbia_heights.notes: Low-risk backup location. Reliable moderate foot traffic from Metro plaza and residential brunch culture. Deploy when weather/events make premium locations risky. Low upside but low downside.

h_street_corridor.notes: Festival-driven. H Street Festival alone brings 4000+ attendees. Growing arts/food destination. Weak mornings, strong evenings on event days. The annual H Street Festival is a must-position day.

navy_yard.address: Half St SE / Maine Ave SW
navy_yard.notes: Nationals Park (41k capacity) is the primary driver April-October. Pre-game crowd 2-3 hours before first pitch is peak. Wharf provides year-round waterfront baseline. Weather-dependent for outdoor positioning.
